notes.title: Development on Vulcan resumes after 2 year break
notes.content: [p]After 2 years of break, I have finally decided to continue development of Vulcan, this time using Godot as the game engine. The art will be more stylized and hopefully my two years of code and development experience will enhance the game! [/p][p][/p][p]Given that this is a slightly new incarnation of the game, some features that were present in the previous one will be overhauled completely, with a substantial amount more being added.[/p][p][/p][p]I am hoping to have a short, (possibly free, maybe cheap) early access available near the end of the summer so that I can receive feedback while developing the bulk of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, Blank Studios LLC[/p]
